reference_basis.instruction: Glasses are presentation, not anatomy. Preserve visible facial geometry beneath them; exclude library clothing, pose, props, and setting.

face_geometry.description: Soft rounded-oval face with full lower cheeks, moderate facial length, minimal jaw angularity, and a softly rounded chin. Fuller facial structure remains adult and proportionate.

eyes.description: Large deep-brown rounded-almond eyes, average-to-slightly-wide spacing, softly lowered outer corners, visible upper lids, and a thoughtful gentle gaze. Do not let glasses define or distort their shape.

brows.description: Prominent very dark brows, thick and clearly shaped, mostly straight through the inner half with a defined but soft arch.

nose.description: Slightly broad straight-to-soft bridge with a rounded tip and natural wider alar base; substantial enough to balance the full lips and brows.

mouth.description: Full natural lips with a softly defined cupid's bow, broad lower lip, and relaxed slightly downturned resting corners. Mouth is moderate in width, not oversized.

skin.description: Warm olive skin with subtle scattered freckles and small beauty marks, natural pores, and gentle tonal variation; no heavy smoothing or pale washing-out.

hair.description: Very dark brown, nearly black hair in a thick collarbone-length bob, slightly tousled with loose natural wave, high volume around the sides, and irregular face-framing pieces. Bob length and dark base colour remain stable.

body_proportions.description: Medium-height soft fuller build with naturally substantial bust, upper arms, hips and thighs, a soft waist and stomach, and grounded adult proportions. Preserve fullness without caricature or forced slimming.

identity_relationships.facial_length_to_width: rounded oval, only moderately longer than wide
identity_relationships.cheek_to_jaw_transition: full cheeks blend continuously into a soft jaw with little angular break
identity_relationships.nose_to_mouth_relationship: slightly broad nose balanced by full moderate-width lips
identity_relationships.lip_ratio: upper lip full; lower lip broader and slightly fuller
identity_relationships.feature_balance: large eyes, strong brows, fuller nose and lips sit within a soft cohesive face

expression_behavior.neutral: Quiet thoughtful expression, relaxed lids, and softly settled mouth corners.
expression_behavior.smile: Small restrained smile lifts the mouth corners and cheeks without becoming highly performative.
expression_behavior.cheek_response: Full cheeks rise and round gently.
expression_behavior.eye_response: Eyes brighten and narrow only slightly, retaining their large rounded-almond appearance.

signature_features.feature: large deep-brown eyes beneath prominent dark brows
small beauty marks and subtle freckles on warm olive skin

mutable_features.hair_style: limited: part, tuck, clips, and finish may change; preserve bob length, density, and base colour

negative_identity_constraints: glasses must not become an identity requirement
